first_reader_said: 1CH 15:18: Both records are the second-degree Levite Benaiah who played the psaltery before the ark.
1CH 15:20: Both records are the second-degree Levite Benaiah who played psalteries on Alamoth.

why: Both records identify the same Benaiah in the second-degree Levite list in 1CH 15:18 and among those playing psalteries on Alamoth in 1CH 15:20. B adds the consistent continuation in 1CH 16:5, where Benaiah serves alongside several of the same musicians, and preserves fuller compatible ties to Levi and Eliab.
